errors.text: The proposed Hf/Mo compositional modification does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo at 1000 °C.
Hf and especially Mo are high-density additions, yet no concentration limit, density calculation, or measured density criterion is provided to support retention of low density.

The cited evidence does not establish that Hf/Mo additions simultaneously improve corrosion and oxidation resistance in a lightweight HEA; E3 supports only mechanical-property investigation in a Ni-rich alloy, while E1 concerns Cr in a refractory coating.
The asserted single-BCC mediator is unsupported and ignores possible intermetallic or precipitate formation from Hf/Mo additions.
The conditions and falsification experiment omit alloy composition, processing route, oxidation temperature and duration, corrosive medium, density threshold, and quantitative acceptance criteria.
